_doc: CPO Product Radar (#159) subjects, seeded from the #158 spike (scripts/spikes/cpo_radar/subjects.json). Lives under src/ (not config/) because the Lambda asset ships src/ only (buildspec rsync src/ -> build/lambda/src/). Pattern: Bluefin identity.py (subject + aliases + official-account allowlist). App IDs from the iTunes search API country=br; channel IDs from YouTube channels.list(forHandle) + subscriber check, 2026-09-26. search_query is the creator-search q (quoted when multiword). onca_entities[0] is the entity the radar events bind to (industries, tenant scoping). BCB fee-table CNPJs are deliberately NOT here: fee tables stay in the monthly pricing lens (#159 out of scope).

products.name: Nubank
products.namesake_risk: 'Nu' alone is too short; never match bare 'nu'.

products.name: Inter
products.namesake_risk: 'Inter' collides with Internacional (football), 'inter' prefix words. Require 'Banco Inter'/'Inter&Co' or channel/app context.

products.name: Mercado Pago
products.namesake_risk: Mercado Livre marketplace news mentions Mercado Pago in passing; the @mercadopago channel is Argentina (Spanish) - use the BR channel. Spanish-language MX/AR creator videos are out of scope.

products.name: C6 Bank
products.namesake_risk: Bare 'C6' collides with cars/chemistry; require 'C6 Bank'/'Banco C6'. Zero-subscriber look-alike channels exist (impersonation is a separate CRO/CISO issue) - only the listed channel id is official.
